name: smwgraphics-super-fantasy-zone-picknica
title: Super Fantasy Zone - Picknica
description:
Here's a layer 3 converted BG shown at Winter C3 2023. This one did prove to be a challenge, but it does use 5 layer 3 palettes. Can be used cleverly with the SMW status. For best results, use DKCR Styled Sprite Status Bar, Remove Status Bar and New Super Mario Bros. Wii Styled Status Bar v1.7.
Credit not required.
